# Targetyan

> Targetyan is a social media marketing agency (SMMA) in Egypt. It helps brands grow with social media strategy, Meta Ads, stop-scrolling reels, persuasive copywriting, SEO and AEO. Founded by Zain Emad (strategy & growth) and Marwan Gado (video editing & montage).

## Main pages
- [Home (English)](https://zainemad.github.io/targetyan/): services, Tailored Package, team, process, booking
- [الصفحة الرئيسية (العربية)](https://zainemad.github.io/targetyan/targetyan-arabic.html): Arabic version of the home page
- [Founder (English)](https://zainemad.github.io/targetyan/founder.html): about Zain Emad, co-founder and growth strategist
- [المؤسس (العربية)](https://zainemad.github.io/targetyan/founder-arabic.html): Arabic founder page

## Services
- Social media strategy
- Account audit and analysis
- Stop-scrolling reels (mobile shooting, professional editing and montage)
- Meta Ads management (Facebook and Instagram)
- Competitor and market research
- Persuasive copywriting

## Tailored Package (2026)
- Includes SEO, AEO, social media management, persuasive copywriting, reels, on-brand designs and sales psychology
- Price: 14,999 EGP (regular 20,000 EGP), limited client slots each month

## How it works
1. Discovery call
2. Audit and strategy
3. Content and ads
4. Optimize and scale
